00 · The shift

What died so far

V2: ten workplaces wearing costumes. V3: one garden cloned nine ways.

Irony reads as a wink. Monoculture reads as a machine. Both read as AI.

What v5 is

Fifteen different animals. Bold, sleek, animated, alive. Footage with a pulse, code with intent.

The variety of v2, the sincerity of v3, the energy of neither. Judged one at a time, not as a set.

T1We grow the thing you dreamed.

T2Bring us a wish. Watch it take root.

T3Ideas, brought to life.

01–15 · Fifteen signals

The v3 lesson, learned: one metaphor nine ways reads as a machine. These fifteen share nothing but the bar: bold, sleek, alive, and each one a different animal. Video where it earns it, code-motion where it does not.

CLICK · OPENS THE COVER · CLICK AGAIN · TURNS THE PAGE

On the real site

The journal sits closed, breathing. Scroll pins the section; the cover opens; each scroll turns one featured build. A plain list stays one click away.

Each spread carries

Page one is the index: every job, logged and ruled. Then the wall of proof, two spreads of real clients with a drawn site card, a one-line promise in the margin, and the stamp: BUILT in red, ON THE BENCH in blue pencil.

Why it wins

Every agency has a case-study grid. Nobody has your notebook. It says handmade, it says history, and it makes each new client want their page in it.

Proof
Testimonials strip.
The Builds journal + the version log. Receipts, not adjectives.

Keep + amplify

  • Sentence case. Periods. Short lines that end.
  • Speak to "you", write as "we".
  • Energy allowed: loud, alive, midnight, joy.
  • Concrete outcomes over capability lists.
  • AI mentioned once, in the toolbox, lowercase energy.

Banned on sight

  • Leverage, unlock, empower, seamless, supercharge.
  • "AI-powered" anything above the fold.
  • Irony, costumes, wink-wink workplace conceits.
  • Em dashes. Exclamation points doing enthusiasm's job.
  • Partnership language implying we join their org.

18 · Motion plan & goals

Ambient · alive at rest

The living layer

Every direction idles differently: EQ bars, chrome sheen, tape grain, neon rain. Alive at rest, never busy.

Earned · you did that

Touch the world

Each direction gets ONE earned interaction with its own physics. Rewarded, never ambushed.

Scroll · the page performs

Growth choreography

Arrivals match the direction: posters slam, chrome sweeps, tape cuts, neon draws. Exits always faster than entrances.

Discipline

The sincerity contract

No irony, no monoculture, no bounce without cause. Transform and opacity only, reduced-motion honored, 60fps on a mid phone or cut.

Goal

Zero template smell

The slop test on every section: if a screenshot could be a Framer template, it goes back.

Goal

Phones first-class

Every world has a designed touch answer. The 375px cell in every component strip is the receipt.

Two poles, your gut: Frequency or Supercolor.

After two misses I am not crowning anything. The honest read: Frequency is the pulse (dark, footage-first, festival energy) and Supercolor is the daylight version of the same joy. Handycam is the sleeper: the most human, the most yours, the hardest to copy. Chrome and Night Drive are the sleek poles if the others run too warm. Walk them one at a time, not as a set, and tell me which one made you scroll slower.
